[quote=tirakan;60963632][b]Press Statement from Acting Premier Arlan Vos [/b]

The Government of Greater Tirakan rejects the assertion that it has insulted, framed, or misrepresented Shahban. No accusation has been made against Shahban's integrity or its right to sovereign decision-making. The claims to the contrary are inaccurate. What Tirakan has addressed, and will continue to address, are the risks arising from policy shifts combined with the breakdown of diplomatic dialogue. We've attempted to approach Shahban. They've turned us down.
In light of the public stance now taken by Shahban, and given the refusal of cooperation, Greater Tirakan will, effective immediately, classify Shahbani resource imports as "[i]strategic industrial inputs[/i]." This classification introduces more enhanced customs procedures and verification checks on Shahbani goods. They are being implemented to guarantee supply-chain integrity. This is a precautionary step, not a punitive one.

Tirakan has not accused Shahban of wrongdoing. However, Tirakan will not disregard the risk that careless political rhetoric and one-sided actions may create vulnerabilities. Responsible governance requires safeguards. Dialogue remains possible. Always. Unlike Shahban, Tirakan will not shut itself down, especially not in the face of the dire and inhumane times East Shamat had to face just a month ago. [/quote]

[b]Statement from the Shahbani Office of Foreign Relations[/b]

Greater Tirakans decision to reclassify Shahbani exports under enhanced controls is not a neutral technical measure, regardless of how it is described.
When administrative barriers are introduced immediately after a political disagreement, they cease to be tools of caution and become instruments of greed. 
Let us make clear that Shahban has not withdrawn from dialogue.
The invocation of external humanitarian crises to justify economic measures against Shahban is inappropriate and an unnecessary escalation.
In response to Tirakans actions, and to show that we will not be toyed with, Shahban will suspend all pending export certifications for strategic minerals destined for markets in Tirakan.
Shahban remains committed to stability and respect.

~ Office of the High Emir

[quote=the_crystalline_empire;60971629]Joseph took a weary look at the two officers who had entered the cabin as they nodded and ordered him to leave the cabin, walking behind him less like guards and more like they were leading a hostage. 

He would be handed a briefcase with the terms and papers for a deal and ordered to leave the ship without ceremony.

The door to the ship would open[/quote]

The doors opened to reveal a modest Korrin gathering standing at the end of the bridge, waiting for Joseph to come to them. In the centre of the gathering stood the Sector Administrator in his black suit, next to him was a representative of the foreign affairs ministry and the owner of the dockyard. Surrounding them were four naval officers, their pistols holstered and arms hidden behind their backs.

As Joseph walked towards the group he could smell fresh paint and metal in the air, welding sparks flickering like fireflies on distant ship hulls while the hum of machinery echoed through the underground complex. The men waiting for him were tall and pale, like most Spacenoids, they looked down at Joseph as he approached with whispering between them.

The first to speak was the Sector Administrator, who first bowed his head in respect, lowering himself to the same height as Joseph. [i]"Greetings, noble friend from Erene. May the stars bless you and your journey. What brings you to our moon?"[/i]
